qualification.details: Sector Expert (S&L Division): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with Minimum 60% marks and Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Experience: Minimum 05 years' post-qualification domain experience in Energy Management/Operations & Maintenance/technical evaluation of Energy Savings/Standards for appliances and equipment, promotion and development. Sector Expert (ADEETIE): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with Minimum 60% marks and Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Experience: Minimum 05 years' post-qualification domain experience in MSME. Sector Expert (ECSBC / Buildings): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Architecture with Minimum 60% marks and Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Experience: Minimum 5 years' post-qualification domain experience relating to Energy Management/technical evaluation of Energy Saving/compliance with Energy Conservation Building Code (ECBC) & Standards/Building Energy Simulation Software/Green Building Ratings. Sector Expert (Artificial Intelligence): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Computer Science or allied discipline with Minimum 60% marks and Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Computer Science/AI & ML/Data Analytics. Experience: Minimum 05 years' post-qualification domain experience in AI/Data Analytics applications relevant to the energy sector. Project Engineer (National Exam Coordinator – NECA): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with Minimum 60% marks and Postgraduate/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology/Energy Planning/Energy Management/Sustainable Energy/Environmental Studies/Environment Science. Experience: Minimum 01 years' post-qualification domain experience in conducting examinations and in Energy Management, auditing, etc.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, for various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BEE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for Project Engineer and Sector Expert posts across different specialized divisions within the Bureau of Energy Efficiency.

faq.question: Q3. What are the specific posts available under this notification?
faq.answer: The posts include Sector Expert for S&L Division, ADEETIE, ECSBC / Buildings, Artificial Intelligence, and Project Engineer for National Exam Coordinator (NECA).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Sector Expert posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or Architecture with minimum 60% marks, along with a Postgraduate or Master's degree in relevant disciplines like Energy Planning, Environmental Science, or Computer Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Engineer (National Exam Coordinator – NECA) position is 30 years as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Sector Expert positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Sector Expert posts will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹1,00,000/- per month during their contractual period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form along with necessary documents is 17-11-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for BEE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates must send their filled applications in the prescribed proforma by post to the designated official address.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Secretary, Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Govt. of India, 4th Floor, Sewa Bhawan, R. K. Puram, Sector-1, New Delhi – 110066.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of eligible candidates will be carried out through a personal interaction round conducted by the competent authority at BEE.
